title: Lunar Candy Love Treehouse
description: A surreal nighttime scene inside a stone archway shows a woman in a pink dress sitting on an ornate chair, releasing glowing pink ears on strings. In the foreground, two women in matching red floral dresses stand close together. Behind them, a massive gnarled tree supports an illuminated treehouse labeled "LUNAR CANDY LOVE" with stairs winding around the trunk.
prompt: A surreal fantasy nighttime scene viewed through a stone archway dripping with red liquid, featuring a woman in a flowing pink dress seated on an ornate wooden chair, releasing numerous glowing pink human ears attached to strings that float upward. In the foreground, two women with long dark hair wearing elaborate red floral dresses stand close together looking at each other. A massive twisted tree in the background supports a brightly lit treehouse with signs reading LUNAR CANDY LOVE, surrounded by red roses, gold coins scattered on the floor, a green aurora and crescent moon in the dark blue sky, hanging lanterns and blue curtains.
